log: THE LOOP -- transcription -> protein -> flux -> growth -> dilution -> transcription
The audit found the cell model's coupling graph is a pure DAG: zero cycles, so nothing it
computes ever feeds back. This closes one cycle and measures whether closing it changes any
answer. Gates G1-G4 were written into the docstring before the run.
